The statement balances solid real activity and a low unemployment rate with inflation still above the 2% objective and explicitly higher two‑sided risks, yielding a cautiously hawkish tone. Consistent with Taylor-type guidance and the Clarida–Galí–Gertler view of interest-rate smoothing, holding the funds rate at 4.25–4.50% while remaining data‑dependent is coherent with rule‑based, gradualism under uncertainty (Söderström; Wieland; Svensson & Woodford). Continuing QT and implementing policy via the IORB/RRP corridor and standing facilities align with the modern operating framework begun in 2008 and help transmit restraint through money markets and term premia (IOER literature; Cochrane–Piazzesi). The emphasis on heightened uncertainty is also in line with “inflation‑at‑risk” considerations, arguing for risk‑management caution despite resilient growth. Net: modestly positive on growth but tempered by inflation and uncertainty.
